title: Ten cyclic fields with occupancy after exact noise-weight removals with exact signed parity shells

claims.statement: The explicit 10-field degree-100 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-27 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5830887700095283/40000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=22071273417164279903693414578170725200796681160 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(153951/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check QR profiles, field, orbits, work and the first three signed pair cutoffs (0), the remaining seven pair cutoffs (1), child noise shells (2), and the full occupancy and error remainder (3).
